title: statics
text: Statics precedes strength of materials. Free body diagrams are part of statics. Equilibrium of forces is based on Newton's laws. Statics requires equilibrium of forces.

title: strength
text: Strength of materials requires statics. Stress analysis is based on strength of materials. Bending moment increases bending stress. Yield strength is measured by a tensile test.

title: concentration
text: Stress concentration requires stress analysis. A keyway increases stress concentration. A shoulder fillet reduces stress concentration. Stress concentration is measured by the stress concentration factor.

title: fatigue
text: Fatigue failure requires stress concentration. Fatigue failure is based on the S-N curve. Cyclic loading causes fatigue failure. Surface finish reduces fatigue strength.

title: shaft
text: Shaft design requires fatigue failure. Shaft design requires bending stress. A rotating shaft is used in gearboxes. Shaft diameter reduces bending stress.

title: gears
text: Gear design requires shaft design. Gear tooth bending is based on the Lewis equation. Gear contact stress causes pitting. Lubrication reduces pitting.

title: bearings
text: Bearing selection requires shaft design. Bearing life is measured by the L10 rating. Misalignment reduces bearing life. Preload increases bearing stiffness.

title: materials
text: Heat treatment increases yield strength. Alloy steel is used in shafts. Material selection precedes shaft design. Corrosion reduces fatigue strength.

title: couplings_a
text: A flexible coupling reduces shaft misalignment.

title: keys_a
text: A parallel key is used in hub connections.

title: springs_a
text: Spring rate is measured by a load test.
